label: MiniMax H3 Reference to Video
description: MiniMax H3 (local) makes a new clip from a prompt that names its references: videos as <Video 1>.. (motion, camera, action), pictures as <Picture 1>.. (identity, style). It does not keep the plate. Output: an EXR sequence at H3's own size from the range's first frame, no audio.
usage: Makes a new clip from references named in the prompt (MiniMax H3). It does not keep the plate.
Videos (motion, camera, action) are <Video 1>.., pictures (identity, style) are <Picture 1>..
Tick video 2/3 and picture 1-9 to add input arrows. Connected inputs are numbered without gaps - the status line lists the tags.
Pick the length in 'frames'. Output: EXRs at H3's own size, no audio.
Optional 'enhance prompt': a local LLM expands your short prompt into H3's structured description (Run enhancer only to preview it in 'refined prompt').
Press Render in ComfyUI; Bring in output reads the result under the node.

highlights: 'roll off' (default) compresses values above 1 going in: highlights return approximate, saturated colours shift, deep shadows are crushed and new near-whites come back hot. 'clip' cuts at 1 and keeps shadows open.
remove audio from prompt description (advanced, on by default): clears the sound sections from the refined prompt. Dialogue in the visual description stays.

License (checked 2026-11): MiniMax H3 Community - not authorized in the US, EU, UK or South Korea, outputs included. Commercial use is free under $20M a year; above that needs MiniMax's written authorization. Outputs can't be used to improve other AI models. This LoRA's own license is unconfirmed.

output.tooltip: H3 makes a display-referred (sRGB) clip at its own size, not the plate's.

knobs.name: prompt
knobs.label: prompt
knobs.tooltip: Name the references by tag: <Video 1> is the main input, then the other connected videos and pictures in order (the status line lists the tags). Describe the new shot.

knobs.name: frames
knobs.label: frames
knobs.tooltip: Clip length: only the counts H3 accepts (17k+5, at 24 fps). It was trained on 124-362 frames (5-15 s); shorter clips may look worse.

knobs.name: megapixels
knobs.label: megapixels
knobs.tooltip: Size H3 renders at, with video 1's aspect (multiple of 32). 0.4 = the template's default (864x480 at 16:9); 0.98 = the official 768p (1344x768).

knobs.name: turbo
knobs.label: turbo
knobs.tooltip: 4-step turbo LoRA: much faster. Off = the full model with 'steps'.

knobs.name: enhance_prompt
knobs.label: enhance prompt
knobs.tooltip: Let the local MiniMax-H3 prompt rewriter (LightX2V LoRA) expand the prompt into H3's structured description first. It looks at the inputs itself. Slower; off = the prompt goes to H3 as typed.

knobs.name: highlights
knobs.label: highlights
knobs.tooltip: roll off (default): the plate and refs go in through ACES Output - sRGB and the result comes back through its inverse, so highlights are compressed instead of cut. Highlights come back approximate, saturated colours shift, deep shadows are crushed, and new near-white pixels come back hot (display 0.98 = about 7, 1.0 = about 16). clip: values above 1 reach the model as 1 (colorimetric), shadows stay open. Comp only the changed area.

knobs.name: remove_audio
knobs.label: remove audio from prompt description
knobs.tooltip: Clears the sound sections of the refined prompt: overall_soundscape and non_diegetic_music become N/A, and the section names stay. Only applies with 'enhance prompt' on. Dialogue written in the visual description stays, and H3 still generates an audio track, which this gizmo doesn't use.

knobs.name: turbo_steps
knobs.label: turbo steps
knobs.tooltip: Steps with turbo on (the LoRA is made for 4).

knobs.name: ref_image_size
knobs.label: ref image size
knobs.tooltip: match = pictures scaled down to the render size (faster). max = up to 2048 px short edge: better likeness, several times slower.
